verdict: FORCE-FIELD-ROBUST NEGATIVE for ESM3 advantage: ESM3 does not beat BLOSUM62 argmax under FoldX 5.1 flexible side-chain ddG (n=133, two-sided paired Wilcoxon p=0.845, rank-biserial +0.020 — statistical tie). Both ESM3 and BLOSUM62 DO beat paired random robustly under FoldX (p=2.8e-03 and 8.9e-04 Holm-adjusted, surviving |ddG|<=10 trimming) — unlike EvoEF2, where ESM3's edge over random died with outlier trimming. The negative core of the EvoEF2 verdict (no ESM3 advantage over a 1992 substitution matrix) is confirmed on a second, independent force field; the EvoEF2-specific claim 'BLOSUM62 significantly beats ESM3' softens to a statistical tie under flexible side chains because FoldX absorbs the fixed-backbone catastrophe outliers (ESM3 max ddG +101.85 EvoEF2 -> +14.17 FoldX).
